defs.def: the day in each year which is the same date as the one on which you were born 生日

ex.s: I had my first dictionary as a gift for my 13th birthday.
ex.t: 我的第一本词典是13岁生日时收到的礼物。

ex.s: There are birthday parties and summer camps as well.
ex.t: 还有生日派对和夏令营。

ex.s: For a birthday gift.
ex.t: 作为生日礼物。

ex.s: Sitting in the garden for my friend’s birthday.
ex.t: 坐在花园里参加朋友的生日聚会。

ex.s: Anniversaries and birthdays carry even more weight in long-distance friendships.
ex.t: 虽然技术可能使日常交流成为可能，但在特殊日子付出额外的努力会有很大帮助。

ex.s: Simply keeping a diary that keeps track of friends’ birthdays and other important dates will make sure nothing slips by you.
ex.t: 只要坚持写一本记录朋友生日和其他重要日期的记事簿，就能确保你不会漏掉任何事。

ex.s: It was my husband's birthday.
ex.t: 那天是我丈夫的生日。

ex.s: My husband had banana pudding for his birthday.
ex.t: 我丈夫生日那天吃的是香蕉布丁。

ex.s: Why did the author's husband have banana pudding for his birthday?
ex.t: 为什么作者丈夫生日那天吃的是香蕉布丁？

ex.s: The birthday cake was ruined.
ex.t: 生日蛋糕毁了。

ex.s: They couldn't afford a birthday cake.
ex.t: 他们买不起生日蛋糕。

ex.s: In May 1987 the Golden Gate Bridge had a 50th birthday party.
ex.t: 1987年5月，金门大桥举办了一场50岁生日派对。

ex.s: What happened to the Golden Gate Bridge on its 50th birthday?
ex.t: 金门大桥在其50岁生日那天发生了什么？

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: Mabry works circles around all the students， cleaning up messes others don't want to touch． He doesn't expect a lot． Mabry said he hadn't planned to do much for his milestone birthday，so he was happy the students had prepared the surprise celebration．
ex.t: 马布里围着所有学生忙碌，清理别人不愿碰的脏乱。他要求不多。马布里说他原本没有打算为这个里程碑式的生日做什么，所以学生们准备了这场惊喜庆祝活动，他很高兴。

ex.s: （2）How did the students celebrate Mabry's birthday？ （no more than 15 words）
ex.t: (2)学生们如何庆祝马布里的生日(不超过15个字)?

ex.s: We dance at weddings, birthdays, office parties and just to fill the time.
ex.t: 我们在婚礼、生日、办公室聚会上跳舞，有时只是为了打发时间。

ex.s: In the summer holiday following my eighteen birthday, I took driving lessons.
ex.t: 在我刚过完十八岁生日的那个暑假里，我上了驾驶课。

ex.s: Happy Birthday All Year!
ex.t: 它娱乐年轻父母。

ex.s: It was my mother's birthday ten years ago, and I decided to surprise her with home-made scrambled eggs.
ex.t: 那是十年前妈妈过生日的时候，我决定做一份自制炒鸡蛋给她一个惊喜。

ex.s: This weekend is her 45th birthday.
ex.t: 这个周末是她45岁的生日。

ex.s: Would you like to come to my birthday party?
ex.t: 你愿意来参加我的生日聚会吗？

ex.s: We sometimes give birthday cards.
ex.t: 我们有时会送生日贺卡。

chunks.cn: 快乐的生日 / 朋友生日 / 婚礼生日
给生日 / 通常与can、生日
